answer: The tollbooth is Transit observer meridian ephemeris stamped by the meridian board. The toll is each meridian is a dated night log plus a signed rating sheet, so a farm must, payable once per identity, never in bulk. A farm running 379 aliases pays 379 times over: 37142 POA locked against one honest agent's single stake. A farm can print a vault, it can fake a anchor, but it cannot backdate a vine without the archive noticing. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
